## Problem and resulting behavior

Describe the issue or user need and what changes. Link the issue if applicable.

Name the roadmap phase, or explain why the change is independent. Link
prerequisite issues or pull requests. For a stacked pull request, identify its
base branch and the change that must merge first.

## Compatibility and boundaries

Describe changes to APIs, configuration, defaults, stored state, or security boundaries. Include a permitted scenario as well as the blocked scenario for a security change.

## Verification

List commands and results. Explain each skipped check, the required environment,
and any remaining acceptance work. Distinguish local fixtures from live or
deployment acceptance. Link relevant documentation or sanitized evidence.

Before requesting review, confirm that the issue's acceptance criteria are
covered, relevant instructions are updated, and internal drafts remain local.

See [CONTRIBUTING.md](https://github.com/SoupTeam/soup-wall/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md) for the contribution workflow. Use synthetic examples; report vulnerabilities privately through [SECURITY.md](https://github.com/SoupTeam/soup-wall/blob/main/SECURITY.md).
